CHERRY CREEK Teen & young adult
therapy, Denver

Denver, CO

Therapy for teens and twentysomethings who are figuring it out as they go, and for the parents watching from the kitchen. No lectures. No clipboard energy. Just an hour a week with someone who’s actually listening.

Sessions are in person in Denver. Headed off to college? Ask on your first call about keeping things going virtually.

Book a free 15-minute call

Services

Who Will works with

01

Teens13 to 17

School stress, anxiety, the 4.2 GPA that still doesn’t feel like enough, vaping, parents who don’t get it. What you say stays private, apart from the few safety exceptions Will explains on day one. Parents get check-ins, not a transcript.

02

Young adults18 to 26

College, a first job, moving back home, or partying that stopped being fun a while ago. The years after high school are supposed to be the best ones. For a lot of people they’re the loneliest.

03

Family sessions

For the parent and teen having the same fight every Sunday night. Sometimes it moves faster with everyone in the room.

04

Substance use

Where Will got his start. Weed, alcohol, vapes, pills. Straight talk, zero scare tactics, and nobody pretending it’s all bad or all fine.

Opening soon

A substance use group, under 26 only.

Small, in person, and run by Will. Less church basement, more real conversation. Dates are coming, so drop your email and you’ll hear first.

About

Hard to shock. Easy to talk to.

Will Flug (William on paper) trained as a social worker at the University of Denver. He works with teens, their parents, and people in their twenties, mostly on getting along with the people around them and saying what they actually mean.

A lot of his background is in substance use. His take: drugs and alcohol usually aren't the problem. They're a solution, just a bad one, and the work is figuring out what they're solving.

He borrows from ACT and DBT. Mostly, a session feels like talking to someone who’s paying attention.

MSW, University of Denver
BA in Psychology, University of Colorado Denver
Licensed Social Worker, State of Colorado
